spec_references: Expressions: [Start action], [Method call], [New expression], [List constructor] and [Mapping constructor] are supported.
Module-level declarations: [Class definition] supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members.
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: `ballerina/lang.value` includes `toString`; `ballerina/lang.string` includes `length`; `ballerina/lang.runtime` includes `sleep`.
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for `value:toString` and `value:toBalString`, and `string:length`.
reason: All essential operations are supported: value:toString in direct and method syntax, Unicode string length, function values, maps, arrays, tuples, JSON, class instances, and futures created with start. The permitted runtime:sleep call precedes future stringification. The asserted numeric lengths and completed-future strings exercise the supported toString behavior; the specification gives no receiver-type restriction on that operation.
test_design_notes: No @args or @panic directives; @output checks lengths and exact future representations.
Future completion is assumed after a one-second sleep rather than synchronized with wait, so scheduling could make the final two output assertions timing-sensitive.
